attributes.board_name: Nevada State Board of Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Classified by the AAPA as Category 1, or NSBME Board approved; at least half within scope of practice/specialty
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated by initial licensure date in the 2025-2027 biennium: 30 hours (Jan-Jun 2026), 20 (Jul-Dec 2026), 10 (Jan-Jun 2027); SBIRT and suicide prevention within 2 years of initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: Attest at each renewal; proof only if selected for the renewal CME audit. No CME for inactive licensees.

topics.who: All licensees: 2 hours in ethics, pain management or addiction care each biennium
All licensees: SBIRT (Screening, Brief Intervention, and Referral to Treatment) within 2 years of initial licensure
Licensees registered to dispense controlled substances: misuse and abuse of controlled substances, opioid prescribing or addiction
All licensees: within 2 years of initial licensure, then every 4 years
PAs whose supervising physician is a psychiatrist: cultural competency and DEI
PAs providing emergency services in a hospital or primary care: stigma and bias toward people with or at risk of HIV, within 2 years of starting

rules.notes: PAs supervised by MDs are licensed by NSBME; PAs supervised by DOs by the Nevada State Board of Osteopathic Medicine (second rule). Up to 4 hours double credit for geriatrics, medication management, rare diseases incl. pediatric cancer.
rules.rule_quote: …(a) If licensed during the first 6 months of the biennial period of registration, 40 hours.

topics.who: All PAs licensed by the osteopathic board: misuse and abuse of controlled substances, opioid prescribing or addiction, every year
PAs supervised by a psychiatrist: cultural competency and DEI, every 2 years
PAs providing emergency services in a hospital or primary care: stigma and bias toward people with or at risk of HIV, within 2 years of starting

rules.notes: Nevada State Board of Osteopathic Medicine (bom.nv.gov) licenses PAs who work with DOs: 20 credits a year, provider of choice for the remainder. Renewal date and fee not stated on the pages read.
